identity.research_question: On the pinned 20-match SkillCorner population, how does access to realized future ball and opponent trajectories change three-second multi-agent player-position error, for absolute pitch XY and origin-relative displacement targets?

benchmarks.historical_relation: new prospective identity; not a version, alias, or repaired membership of a historical reconstructed benchmark

benchmarks.target_frame: per-player XY delta from the exact observed forecast-origin position
benchmarks.historical_relation: new prospective identity; not a version, alias, or repaired membership of a historical reconstructed benchmark

window_population.origin_candidates: every canonical 5 Hz sample with the complete 41-sample support
window_population.eligible_population_rule: retain every candidate passing the pinned eligibility policy; no outcome- or model-dependent subsampling

forbidden_model_information: future target positions or target-derived features
future eligibility decisions or reason codes
future target masks or target membership
numeric match, team, or player identifiers as learned features
absolute match clock, file identity, or row order

target_panel.target_entity_source: player records with finite XY in the forecast-origin sample
target_panel.target_entity_order: ascending provider player_id within match and team
target_panel.target_cardinality: variable and fixed per directed scene from the origin sample; no fixed eleven-player shape or cap
target_panel.identity_scope: match-scoped provider player_id only; no cross-match athlete identity or ID embedding
target_panel.continuity: keep each origin target ID in its origin order for the full 15-step output; never stitch IDs
target_panel.absolute_xy: predict provider pitch-centered x/y directly in metres, without normalization, rotation, or attack-direction transformation
target_panel.origin_relative_displacement: predict future x/y minus the same target player's finite origin x/y, in metres; reconstruct physical XY by adding that origin position
target_panel.target_truth_mask: one null XY pair only when that origin target is absent or either source coordinate is null/nonfinite at that future sample
target_panel.extrapolated_truth: finite source XY with is_detected=false remains a scored target; retain its source-quality stratum
target_panel.substitution: target membership stays fixed from the origin sample; a departing target is null-masked only when its source position is absent or invalid, and later entrants are never added
target_panel.imputation: none; no forward fill, interpolation, or replacement target
target_panel.prediction_mask: none; each model must emit finite XY predictions for every origin target at every future sample
target_panel.mask_use: evaluation only; never a model input

split.role_assignment_algorithm: rank matches by ascending SHA-256 of UTF-8 'FPDBench prospective/v1/match/' + decimal match_id; assign first 12 to training, next 4 to validation, last 4 to evaluation; sort IDs ascending within each role

lomo.training_membership_rule: all training-role matches except that fold's held-out match
lomo.use: descriptive match-held-out generalization only; LOMO scores do not select a model or tune a result
lomo.uncertainty: do not report iid standard errors, confidence intervals, or hypothesis tests across these overlapping training folds

split.cross_match_leakage_rule: all windows, both directed scenes, and all derived rows from a physical match inherit exactly one role or one LOMO fold

evaluation.evaluation_population: all eligible windows in the four fixed evaluation-role matches

primary_metric.formula: mean Euclidean XY error across valid target-player by future-sample pairs within one directed scene

secondary_metrics.formula: mean Euclidean XY error at the fifteenth future sample over target players with valid truth there
square root of mean squared x/y scalar residual over valid target-player by future-sample pairs

evaluation.scene_scoreability: a directed scene is scoreable only if at least one origin target has valid truth at future sample 15; use the same scoreable scene population for all three metrics
evaluation.truth_mask_denominator: finite source XY pairs for origin target IDs only; is_detected=false counts as finite truth per Linear issue 437

null_and_error_rules.invalid_or_missing_prediction: fail the model cell; never drop a model-specific row
null_and_error_rules.no_valid_final_target_in_scene: null scene metric with reason NO_FINAL_TARGET; exclude that scene from every metric and count it
null_and_error_rules.no_scoreable_scene_in_match: null match metric; retain the match and report no four-match descriptive mean or contrast summary if any evaluation match lacks a score
null_and_error_rules.constant_truth: valid for ADE/FDE/XY-RMSE; no SRE or calibrated reward is produced
null_and_error_rules.partial_xy_pair: error; missingness is represented only by a null XY pair
null_and_error_rules.no_scoreable_scene_in_window: null window metric; retain and count the window, but exclude it from the within-match mean

aggregation_order: compute each metric over valid target-player/time labels within each directed scene
average scoreable home/away directed scenes equally within each physical window; exclude every NO_FINAL_TARGET scene from every metric and count it
average eligible physical windows with at least one scoreable scene equally within each match; retain and count windows with no scoreable scene
average the four evaluation-match scores equally only when every evaluation match has a score; otherwise the population metric is null

analysis.primary_model_class: the single model class labeled primary in Linear issue 339, with its exact identity frozen before training

planned_directional_contrasts.directional_expectation: context ADE is lower than control ADE
context ADE is lower than control ADE
context ADE is lower than control ADE
context ADE is lower than control ADE

analysis.confirmatory_scope: none; the four preregistered directional ADE contrasts are descriptive and carry no significance claims
analysis.match_level_contrast: within each evaluation match, control ADE minus context ADE; positive means lower error with the added future context
analysis.directional_contrast_reporting: report all four match-level control-minus-context ADE differences and their equal-match mean as descriptive values; no p-values, confidence intervals, multiplicity corrections, or significance claims

uncertainty.method: descriptive match-level directional ADE contrasts; no inferential tests
uncertainty.multiplicity: not applicable; no hypothesis tests or significance claims
uncertainty.missing_match: do not drop a match; if any evaluation match lacks a required cell or score, the across-match contrast summary is not estimable
uncertainty.lomo_inference: not estimable because LOMO training sets overlap

analysis.robustness_reporting: descriptive only, retain the Linear issue 437 stratum definitions and thresholds; report match and valid-label counts; no post hoc bins or confirmatory tests
exploratory_analyses: model-class comparisons outside the Linear issue 339 primary model class
interactions, horizon-specific slices, and robustness-stratum comparisons
analysis.team_plausibility_metrics: not part of this protocol; Linear issue 439 owns any later decision

selection_and_execution.lomo_fit_role: training, leaving one training match out per fold
selection_and_execution.validation_usage: checkpoint selection and early stopping only, plus only the hyperparameter choices expressly frozen in Linear issue 339
selection_and_execution.selection_metric: equal mean of the four validation-match ADE values
selection_and_execution.evaluation_usage: one final evaluation after feature, model, selection, and run identities are frozen; never for model selection, early stopping, retries, or threshold changes

seed_policy.aggregation: average seed results within each match before descriptive match-level contrasts

stopping_conditions: stop at the fixed Linear issue 339 run or campaign compute ceiling
stop a run only at the Linear issue 339 fixed early-stopping or maximum-step rule
do not add cells, seeds, retries, or training time in response to outcomes
a missing primary cell leaves the descriptive contrast set incomplete; do not report a four-match summary

owns_before_any_training: exact executable experiment matrix and one primary model-class identity
exact seed IDs and seed count
run order and result manifest schema
may_not_change: the Linear issue 336 benchmark identities, targets, regimes, match roles, LOMO assignments, metrics, planned directional contrasts, or descriptive-only analysis policy

issue_439.owns: any later secondary team-coherence or team-plausibility metric decision

pretraining_requirements: Linear issue 336 independent scientific review accepted and issue complete
Linear issue 339 complete with every delegated decision frozen before outcomes
